title: The LP Break-Even Frontier
description: Does an AMM LP out-earn the arbitrage bots picking off its stale quotes? Plot fee income (flat) against LVR = σ²/8 (rising with vol²): where they cross is break-even. At low turnover even BTC sits in the red. Flip on solver-auction recapture and the frontier slides right.

dataSource.label: Crypto.com Exchange — 30-day realized vol; Uniswap v3 fee via Blockscout
